warnings: Cross-section through a typical bay. It is the single most useful sheet for tying architectural labels to structural marks: the steel members are named here by SECTION (WF 400x200x8x13, WF 150x150x7x10, C100x50x20x3.2) rather than by mark (CX, B2, B1), and they match S-02's หมายเหตุ exactly.
'เสา คสล. 0.25x0.25' printed on this section independently confirms the C-1 pedestal size from S-05 -- the only architectural sheet that dimensions the RC pedestal.

Vertical chain: 1.00 ground-to-floor, 2.40 floor-to-eave-soffit, ~2.25 eave-to-ridge (marked approximate). This section agrees with the GABLE elevations (2.25) and not with the long elevations (~2.46) -- see the ridge-height conflict recorded on หน้า07.

Horizontal chains: 1.125 / 6.15 / 1.20 upper, 0.075 / 3.60 / 3.60 / 0.075 middle (the grid plus B1 half-depths), 1.20 / 7.20 / 1.20 lower (grid span plus both eaves), and 1.50 with 4 ลูกนอน @0.375 for the stair.
